name: Eurojackpot
verdict: Eurojackpot in the Netherlands is a game of Nederlandse Loterij B.V., whose shareholders are the Dutch state (Ministry of Finance), NOC*NSF and Stichting Aanwending Loterijgelden Nederland. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Nederlandse Loterij is partly state-owned (Staat der Nederlanden via the Ministry of Finance, one voting shareholder) alongside NOC*NSF and Stichting Kansspelbelangen; it remits net proceeds to the Dutch state. A state shareholding alone is not a rating. Gambling operator: Feyenoord sleeve partner 2026-2030 (home and away shirts).
